nodes.text: In the land of Tribalibot
people grow like this, of necessity.
Our father Adam:
he received the knowledge from God;
he gave names to all things,
both wild and tame;
he also knew the nature of each,
and besides, the circling of the stars,
and of those same planets
what powers they had;
he also knew the might of all herbs
and what the nature of each one was.
When his children had gained the strength
of years, so that they became fruitful
with human offspring,
he warned them against intemperance.
Whenever one of his daughters was with child,
very often he spoke to them of this;
he seldom left off this counsel to them:
he bade them avoid many herbs
that perverted human offspring
and dishonoured his lineage,
otherwise than God measured us
when he sat over me at his work.
